title: Replication of the Taste of Sugar by Formulation of Noncaloric Sweeteners with Mineral Salt Taste Modulator Compositions.
authors: DuBois G, San Miguel R, Hastings R, Chutasmit P, Trelokedsakul A.
figures:
Effects of KCl, MgCl 2 , CaCl 2 , and a KCl/MgCl 2 /CaCl 2  blend on 500 mg/L REBA
taste in a CA/TPC
buffer in comparison to the taste of sucrose in a CA/TPC buffer. The
error bars represent 1 SE. For mouthfeel intensity and sweetness linger,
any two samples with no letters in common are significantly different
at the 99% confidence level based on Tukey’s HSD post hoc test.

Effects of KCl/MgSO 4 ·7H 2 O/Ca(Lactate) 2 ·5H 2 O TMCs on the taste of a commercial sucralose
(169 mg/L)/acesulfame-K (127 mg/L)-sweetened zero-calorie cola. The
error bars represent 1 SE. For mouthfeel intensity and sweetness linger,
any two samples with no letters in common are significantly different
at the 99% confidence level based on Tukey’s HSD post hoc test.

Effects of KCl/MgSO 4 ·7H 2 O/Ca(Lactate) 2 ·5H 2 O TMCs on the taste of a commercial aspartame-sweetened
(520 mg/L) zero-calorie cola. The error bars represent 1 SE. For mouthfeel
intensity and sweetness linger, any two samples with no letters in
common are significantly different at the 99% confidence level based
on Tukey’s HSD post hoc test.

Effects of a KCl/MgCl 2 /CaCl 2  TMC on the taste
of a REBA-sweetened/50% calorie-reduced orange juice. The error bars
represent 1 SE. For mouthfeel intensity and sweetness linger, any
two samples with no letters in common are significantly different
at the 99% confidence level based on Tukey’s HSD post hoc test.

Effects of the KCl/MgSO 4 ·7H 2 O/Ca(Lactate) 2 ·5H 2 O TMC on the taste of a full-calorie HFCS-55-sweetened
citrus-flavored carbonated beverage. The error bars represent 1 SE
unit. For mouthfeel intensity, any two samples with no letters in
common are significantly different at the 99% confidence level based
on Tukey’s HSD post hoc test.
